meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 会先采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的真实榜单数据，再提炼热门题材、新题材信号与书名规律，输出市场概况与题材热度排行报告，并给出 2-3 个可写选题方向及可行性、风险判断。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜，或提到「长篇什么火」等关键词时触发；用户提供榜单截图或链接、要求分析或对比某平台排行榜时也会进入。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火
say.note: 会采集起点月票榜并输出题材热度排行

say.text: 长篇什么火？分析番茄男频阅读榜最近在涨的题材
say.note: 进入扫榜流程，给出题材分布与信号

say.text: 对比起点和晋江的榜单，找出两边都在涨的题材
say.note: 跨平台对比分析共同趋势

howto.what_en: Collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang, etc., finds hot genres, new signals, and naming patterns, then outputs a report with genre rankings and 2-3 topic suggestions with feasibility and risk notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user enters /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜, mentions keywords like '长篇什么火' or '起点排行', provides ranking screenshots or links, or asks to analyze or compare platform rankings.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking and tell me what genres are trending.
say_en.note: Collects the monthly ticket list and outputs genre ranking.

say_en.text: What genres dominate Fanqie's male reading list right now?
say_en.note: Enters the scan flow and gives genre distribution.

say_en.text: Compare Qidian and Jinjiang rankings and find genres rising on both.
